subject: [PATCH 5/5] mm/gup: walk multiple PTEs per follow_page_pte() call

2026-08-01.patch_summary: This patch improves the performance of __get_user_pages() by allowing it to walk multiple PTEs in a single call, rather than restarting the page table walk and re-taking the PTE lock for each page. This is particularly beneficial for large folios (mTHP) where the current approach results in significant overhead. The patch also introduces refcount batching, which reduces the number of times the kernel needs to grab references to pages. Measurements show a significant improvement in performance, with median get time reduced by up to 14.5x in certain scenarios.
